title: fix(toolbar): wrap buttons in narrow containers
body:
## Summary / 摘要

  Allow the toolbar to wrap in narrow containers and prevent the electron demo layout from overflowing when the window is small.

  ## Motivation / 背景与动机

  The editor toolbar previously stayed on one line and showed a horizontal scrollbar in narrow windows, which made the toolbar visually collide with adjacent panels.

  ## Changes / 变更内容

  - `packages/plugin-toolbar`:
    - Allow toolbar buttons to wrap across rows in narrow containers.
    - Add a regression test for the wrapping style.
  - `apps/electron-demo`:
    - Add minimal overflow protection for the top toolbar.
    - Add `min-width: 0` to the editor column so it can shrink correctly in the flex layout.

  ## Testing / 测试

  - [x] `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-toolbar/test/plugin-toolbar.test.ts --config vitest.config.ts`
  - [x] `pnpm typecheck`
  - [x] `pnpm test`
  - [x] `pnpm build`
  - [x] `pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-electron-demo build`
  - [x] Manual UI check in electron-demo: narrow the app window and verify toolbar buttons wrap instead of showing the previous horizontal overflow.

  ## Compliance / 合规自检

  - [x] AI disclosure: AI assistance was used to discuss and review the implementation. The final code was reviewed before submission.
  - [x] New dependencies: none
  - [x] No build artifacts committed
  - [x] No secrets / `.env` / personal vault data committed
